# Your Daily Briefing — Sunday 18 October

Yesterday was a solid effort — 5.6km in 33 minutes with a 153bpm average HR shows you were working at a decent aerobic intensity, and 14,601 steps is a genuinely active day. The calorie burn of 2,947kcal gave you good headroom against your 2,300 target, which is useful for your weight journey toward 80-85kg.

The recovery picture is mixed though. Your HRV at 92ms sits below your 100-120ms baseline, and only 4.8 hours sleep is the real culprit here. Your body simply hasn't had enough time to repair. Keep today's session easy — think Zone 2, conversational pace — rather than anything structured or intense.

Tonight, prioritise sleep above everything else. Aim for 7.5-8 hours — it'll bring that HRV back up faster than any supplement. Hit your 175g protein target today too; it'll support recovery while keeping you on track toward your weight goal.
